rentals.owner_text: The letter date is saved the first time you touch anything in the tenant window, for example typing the Vorauszahlungen, choosing 'Settle by' or opening the PDF. If you mark the letter sent on a later day, it keeps that old date and due date. Example: you edit Lena's Vorauszahlungen on 20.12.2026 and tap Mark as sent on 05.01.2027. The letter and Controlling say 20.12.2026, due 19.01.2027, and the 'Frist passed' warning for her 180 € Nachzahlung never shows. Freezing the date when you open the PDF you actually print and post is reasonable; freezing it on any small edit is the bug.

On 05.01.2027 the panel shows 'Letter | not sent yet · Frist 31.12.2026' with no 'Frist passed', and the Letter details line shows '20.12.2026'. Mark as sent wrote abr_results [['2026-12-20','2027-01-19',180,1]], and the panel then says 'sent 20.12.2026'. In the code, _srCollectTenant writes every [data-srt] input, including the default date/addr/anlagen/days. It is called by the change handler, 'via', 'vzUse', 'brief' and _srPdf, each followed by _srQueueTenantSave. _srSendNow then uses ts.date || today, and the late flag uses the same date. Why 'partly': the date is visible in the folded 'Letter details' line, and freezing it at PDF creation keeps the archive equal to a letter you printed that day. The audit's own example (PDF opened 09.11., sent 20.11.) is that defensible case. The clear bug is freezing on non-letter edits, which also hides the Frist warning. No owner decision found.
